caption: Step 2 of onboarding proposes the fields to pull from a purchase order, such as Order Number, Order Date and Buyer Email, plus a Line Items table. We kept the suggestions.
Our 3 page test purchase order came back Approved in under 30 seconds, with all six line items read. None of the 11 fields or 30 line cells was wrong. Workspace and account details are hidden.
Export offers XLSX, CSV, JSON and XML, and can export only the Line Items table. We downloaded a CSV. Workspace and account details are hidden.
Yearly prices in the app: Starter $49 a month billed $588 for 500 pages, Pro $149 for 2,000 pages and Scale $299 for 5,000 pages a month. Account details are hidden.
After the upload the trial credits fell from 20 to 17, one credit per page of our 3 page order. Workspace and account details are hidden.
